source_facts: The test samples allocator metrics before prepare_mixed_rank_block, not immediately before arena allocation.
prepare_mixed_rank_block_pending first calls prepare_bf16_gemmex, then allocates the decoded arena.
prepare_bf16_gemmex_plans allocates one storage buffer including a 32 MiB workspace plus staging.
The allocator classifies requests >16 MiB as Huge and increments huge_allocations for every such request.
The small fixture then allocates a 128 MiB decoded root; both requests are inside the asserted delta.
interpretation: Aggregate test scope includes the GemmEx provider storage as well as the root; delta=2 alone does not prove two cache roots.
required_followup: Model owner must isolate root-allocation evidence from unrelated provider preparation, retaining exactly-one-root and full physical-budget assertions. Do not simply relax the expected count or rerun this frozen binary.
